title: Harder To Kill
author: Iron And Sand
desc:
HARDER TO KILL

Forged Under the Bar. Tested Under the Load.

Harder to Kill is an integrated strength and conditioning programme combining fundamental barbell training with unconventional strength work using sandbags, kegs, logs, farmers' handles and other awkward implements.

Built upon the principle that strength should be both developed and tested in the real world, the programme combines progressive barbell lifts with demanding carries, lifts, and power-endurance challenges.

The gym builds the foundation. The real world puts it to work.

Harder to Kill develops strength, work capacity, resilience and the ability to handle heavy, awkward loads under fatigue.

This isn't just about lifting more weight. It's about becoming stronger, tougher, and more physically capable.

Four workouts each week.
Four weeks of serious training.
Then repeat and progress......because the battle never ends.
